scripts.gen:api: DROPPEN_EXPORT_ROOT=$(mktemp -d) && DROPPEN_CONFIG_DIR=$DROPPEN_EXPORT_ROOT/config DROPPEN_DATA_DIR=$DROPPEN_EXPORT_ROOT/data APP_INSTANCE=openapi-export DROPPEN_ALLOW_MISSING_WEB_DIST=1 cargo run --quiet --manifest-path server-rs/Cargo.toml -- export-openapi --out openapi/openapi.json; status=$?; rm -rf $DROPPEN_EXPORT_ROOT; [ $status -eq 0 ] && pnpm --filter @remote-hand/web gen:api
scripts.test: pnpm --filter @remote-hand/web test && DROPPEN_ALLOW_MISSING_WEB_DIST=1 cargo test --manifest-path server-rs/Cargo.toml
scripts.build:web:app: rm -rf web/dist && DROPPEN_WEB_MODE=cloud DROPPEN_WEB_ROLE=app pnpm --filter @remote-hand/web build
scripts.build:web:site: rm -rf web/dist && DROPPEN_WEB_MODE=cloud DROPPEN_WEB_ROLE=site pnpm --filter @remote-hand/web build
scripts.deploy:web:my: corepack enable 2>/dev/null || true; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git log -1 --format=%ct) pnpm build:web:app && npx --yes wrangler@4.152.0 deploy -c web/wrangler.my.jsonc
scripts.deploy:web:www: corepack enable 2>/dev/null || true; pnpm install --frozen-lockfile && SOURCE_DATE_EPOCH=$(git log -1 --format=%ct) pnpm build:web:site && npx --yes wrangler@4.152.0 deploy -c web/wrangler.www.jsonc
